g.text: Each point is an independently executed budget endpoint. Lines only guide the eye; no smoothing or monotonicity constraint.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: Identical paired tasks, seeds and conditions at every budget. Failures and zero-attempt cells remain; oracle assumes perfect outcome selection.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: Pointwise 95% task-bootstrap and pale conservative bounded-mean intervals; not simultaneous. No success timestamps or interruption reservations define the x-axis.
